cases.description: The retained headless suite exactly as WO-08 left it (400 cases = 388 pre-WO-08 + 12 WO-08; every WO-09 case excluded by name), rerun after the WO-09 engine changes (the painter comparator, SelectFrame, the iterative hierarchy walkers + Scene::kMaxHierarchyDepth, the Flow/Story loader try scopes, the SceneSerializer nesting gate + duplicate-id policy, the ScriptHost destroy hook, the JobSystem stop-flag reset, the FlowMachine deque). test_crossbuild_scene's WO-09 extension is named '2D engine (WO-09 C05) ...' and is therefore INCLUDED here as a retained-obligation extension, so the expected count is 401 (400 retained + 1).

The six pre-WO-08 2D golden cases (sprites, tilemap, light2d, light2d A/B, ui, scene2d) through the wrapper's before/after SHA-256 of tests/render/goldens: all 17 goldens must be byte-unchanged and no .actual/.diff diagnostics may appear.

The 24 WO-08 render cases (R01-R06 = 22 run + the 2 R07 perf cases, which stay skip(true) here) rerun after the WO-09 engine changes, with the golden dir hashed before/after (wo08_primitives / wo08_text / instancing2d byte-unchanged).
